findings.detail: Recursive review now includes paths such as module/src/file.go, but render_guides still resolves module/AGENTS.md using the superproject's revision and object database. That lookup cannot cross a gitlink, so historical child instructions are omitted. Because the prompt also prohibits loading checkout instructions, review can succeed without applying mandatory child checks.
findings.fix: Resolve child guidance in the child's object database at the gitlink revision selected by the trusted parent baseline, recursively. Handle absent baseline children explicitly and report unavailable required historical objects.
findings.title: write-bash-scripts: Checked commands: Recursive reviews omit historical child instructions.

strengths: Canonical membership keeps collection and consumers consistent.
Fixtures cover nested changes, index-only edits, replacements and symlink handling.
summary: Reviewed the complete committed scope and found one Important defect in recursive historical-guidance resolution. Bash syntax and shared-copy checks passed; runtime fixtures were not run because they create files.
